purpose: require uncertainty-supported transferability as well as group-wise calibration before a probabilistic ecological-state forecaster can enter model-selection Pareto comparison
decision_order: audit every independent group's point transfer sign
audit every independent group's empirical coverage
bootstrap held-out gains using caller-declared blocks within each group
require every group bootstrap lower bound to exceed zero
compare only robustly trusted candidates by gain, minimum group lower bound, worst group coverage error and region size

known_truth_candidates.robust_balanced: positive transfer with strong block-supported lower bounds and calibrated groups
known_truth_candidates.fragile_point_positive: all point gains positive and coverage calibrated, but block-bootstrap intervals cross zero
known_truth_candidates.robust_broad: robustly transferable and calibrated but broader and lower-gain than robust_balanced
known_truth_candidates.coverage_failure: strong robust transfer but one group has 0.60 coverage
known_truth_candidates.too_few_blocks: positive point transfer and calibrated coverage but only four blocks per group, so uncertainty is unavailable
